create_team_with_members: create a new team with admin and user members using the new_team helper
add_member_to_team: add a member to an existing team by user_id or user_email using add_member
delete_team_member: delete a team member by user_id or user_email using the delete_member helper
update_member_budget: update a team member's max budget within a team using update_member
test_team_budget_enforcement: test that a team member's budget blocks API calls after spend exceeds the limit
